zoe: Quick thread pricing experiment for the July webinar. Need to finalize calculator placement and confirm SEO strategy for tier variants.

mike: SEO note: if we change visible tier names, server-side variant is needed to avoid cloaking. We should also canonicalize the page and expose variant info in a robots-allow header for partners.

trina: I'm on FAQ updates. Will focus copy on trial credits, metering & overage, reserved capacity, private deployment, and SLA definitions. Will include a short blurb for how quantization/packing affects cost estimates shown in calculator.

analytics-bot: Registered experiment id=px_5992 | variants: calc-top vs calc-bottom | metrics: pricing_cta_clicks, calc_engagement, webinar_signup_rate | start: 2026-07-20 | duration: 14d

zoe: Ownership recap: Mike (server-side rollout + SEO), Trina (FAQ + CS playbook), I will coordinate the benchmark slides for webinar. Also we'll add registration fields: interest_tier, company_size_bucket, workload_type.

mike: For routing, add boolean wants_enterprise_followup and private_deploy flag. Simple mapping rules, then webhook to /lead-router/v2.

trina: Will drop draft FAQ in #support by EOD and request CS review.

zoe: Let's keep the benchmark slides concise. Two slides: cost per 100k tokens (chat vs embeddings) + latency percentiles. Appendix link for raw data.

analytics-bot: Event spec: internal link posted to /experiments/px_5992/spec. GTM tags also included.

zoe: Cool. Monday 11am PT check-in. Please have copy + experiment heatmap ready.
